title: Fixed Splayed Foot and Open Tapered Nozzle Fire Monitor
description: One newly authored complete portable ground fire-monitor static exterior. Four full splayed arms end in separate flat ground shoes around one low integral two-cheek fork. A single continuous thick hollow feed body rises from a real open rear collar through two bends into a long inclined tapered nozzle with a genuine open tip. Independent fixed lateral trunnions join the tube wall to both full fork cheeks without crossing the bore. A whole three-spoke open side handwheel, opposite full retaining cap and one continuous rearward U handle complete the assembly. Every shape and coordinate is newly authored; no old hose reel, parked hose nozzle, hydrant or single elbow-pipe mesh is imported, extracted, scaled or renamed. The complete ground fork/trunnioned returning body/forward nozzle/control relation is distinct from an elbow on display pedestals or a coiled hose storage stand. One prop zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres, Z up and true horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. Empty fixed illustrative appearance only: no water or foam, firefighting or crowd-control effect, pressure or flow capacity, sealed passage, coupling compatibility, aiming/elevation movement, recoil restraint, stability, operation, manufacturing or safety certification. This is not real equipment design or use guidance. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made or verified.
